conflicts.remarks_quote: This property applies only to assembly configurations. SOLIDWORKS always returns false when you get this property on a part configuration. Setting this property on a part configuration has no effect.
conflicts.example_quote: 1. Open a part that contains one or more configurations.
conflicts.why: 示例前置写明打开 part，且在第 63 行读取该属性；Remarks 明写零件配置上恒为 false、设置无效 —— 示例演示的正是被排除的一类。

results.note: 另一份示例前置写「part or assembly」，不构成冲突，故只取 Change_Configuration_Properties 这一份。

conflicts.remarks_quote: This property applies only to inactive configurations. This property applies to new mates and features for assembly configurations.
conflicts.example_quote: 1. Open a part that contains one or more configurations.
conflicts.why: Remarks 把适用范围限定为装配配置的新配合/新特征，示例的前置与 Dim Part As SldWorks.PartDoc 却是零件，两边给的文档类型前提不一致。

results.note: Remarks 未说零件配置上读取会返回什么，故只报适用范围口径不一致，不报恒假。
